title: Scotland's national animal is a UNICORN?! 🦄 #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. called himself a genius… big mistake. 🤖
Fizzo had three facts ready. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #robot #shorts
facts_checked: The unicorn is Scotland's official national animal (on the royal coat of arms since the 1400s).
Bananas contain potassium-40, so they are very slightly radioactive; the amount is harmless.
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
